units: <cite ref="Taanit 11a:4">Taan. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>כל … בשני ר׳</he> he who denies himself enjoyments in years of famine.
<cite ref="Yoma 74b:11">Yoma 74ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>ענוי ר׳</he> the affliction by fasting.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 40:2">Gen. R. s. 40</cite> <he>קפץ צליו ר׳ ולא הקפיד וכ׳</he> famine came upon him, but he was not agitated and complained not.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:10:1">Koh. R. to V, 10</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 8:3">Deut. VIII, 3</cite>) <he>וכי מאכל ר׳ וכ׳</he> did the Lord give Israel the manna as food of famine (in scantiness)?; a. fr.
